name: zclass_shutdown_core
description: zClass::ShutdownCore deletes world nodes, frees type-list links, releases the node array, resets node counters/current ZBD path, clears initialization state, and returns zero.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly at 0x451a00 calls zClass_List::DeleteAllOfType(6), calls zClass_TypeList::FreeAll, frees g_zClass_NodeArray when g_zClass_NodeArraySize is positive and the pointer is non-null, clears node array size and active count, sets g_zClass_NodeFreeHeadIndex to -1, calls zClass::ResetCurrentZbdPath, clears g_zClass_IsInitialized, and returns zero.
Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x451a00 has no warnings or tags and shows the same shutdown sequence, provider free call, global resets, ResetCurrentZbdPath call, and zero return.
The dependency frontier for 0x451a00 has no visible functional-lane blockers after accepting DeleteAllOfType, zClass_TypeList::FreeAll, ResetCurrentZbdPath, and the free provider.

The native zclass_shutdown_core_smoke reaches ShutdownCore through zClass::Shutdown and verifies node-array globals, active count, free-head index, initialization state, and current ZBD path are cleared; zclass_init_smoke calls ShutdownCore after Init to release the initialized node array.
